name: RetroArch
notes: RetroArch alone defines no rom folder. rgui_browser_directory starts empty and only a platform default fills it, which no desktop driver sets (os configuration.c:3126,3295-3298).

Content reaches a core through playlists built by scanning against the content databases (os tasks/task_database.c), or from the file browser with a core the user picks. The system can only come from the game itself or from a folder the user names.
